About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About Bybit and this role

Bybit is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, with a distributed workforce operating across many countries and time zones around the clock. Our people work in a fast-moving, highly regulated industry where speed, trust, and clarity matter every day.
This is a new role. As Bybit scales, how people experience the company has to be designed on purpose, not left to chance. The Head of Employee Experience & Innovation will build that experience end to end: the offices we work in, how employees hear from leadership, how we come together, and how engaged and connected people feel.

Mission

Make Bybit a place where talented people across every location feel informed, connected, and able to do their best work, and use data and new ideas, including AI, to keep improving that experience as we grow.

Key responsibilities

Employee engagement

  • Design and run the employee listening strategy: engagement surveys, pulse checks, lifecycle surveys, and exit insights.
  • Turn results into action plans with leaders, and track progress so employees see their feedback lead to change.
  • Shape the employee journey from onboarding to exit, removing friction at key moments.
  • Lead recognition programs and culture initiatives that reinforce Bybit's values.
  • Build community and belonging programs, including employee networks and wellbeing initiatives.

Internal events

  • Own the internal events calendar: all-hands, town halls, leadership offsites, team celebrations, and company milestones.
  • Deliver events across locations and formats (in person, hybrid, virtual) with clear goals, budgets, and measures of success.
  • Ensure events are inclusive and respectful of the cultural and religious diversity of our workforce.
  • Manage vendors, budgets, and logistics with strong cost discipline.

Internal communications

  • Build the internal communications strategy and editorial calendar.
  • Own and manage all internal communications channels: the intranet, company newsletter, all-company email, Slack or Lark channels, office digital screens, and leadership updates.
  • Own intranet content management end to end: content strategy, site structure, governance, publishing workflows, and keeping information accurate and current.
  • Set content standards and train content owners across functions so every team publishes clearly and consistently.
  • Partner with the CEO, executives, and the CPO on leadership messaging, change communications, and announcements.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Compliance so sensitive or regulated messages are accurate and consistent.
  • Measure reach and understanding, and keep improving how information flows across the company.

Innovation

  • Bring new tools and ideas to the employee experience, including AI-enabled self-service, chat assistants, and automation of routine People processes.
  • Run small pilots, measure results, and scale what works.
  • Work with HR Technology and IT to keep the People tech stack simple, connected, and easy to use.

Leadership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team across the four areas above.
  • Own the function's budget and vendor relationships.
  • Serve as a member of the People Leadership Team and a trusted partner to senior business leaders.

Workplace operations

  • Lead the global Workplace Operations team that manages Bybit's offices in Dubai (UAE), Malaysia, Hong Kong, and Singapore.
  • Own office strategy and space planning, including openings, moves, expansions, and fit-outs, in partnership with Finance.
  • Set consistent workplace standards across all sites: facilities, health and safety, front desk, amenities, and spaces that support diverse needs such as prayer and wellness rooms.
  • Manage facilities vendors, service contracts, and office budgets with strong cost discipline.
  • Partner with IT, Security, and Legal on physical security, access, business continuity, and emergency response.
  • Use occupancy data and employee feedback to design offices people want to work in.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

Area
Outcome
Workplace operations
Consistent workplace standards across all four office locations; office space plan and budget agreed with Finance
Engagement
Company-wide listening program launched, with action plans owned by every executive
Internal events

Innovation

Team

What you bring

Requirements

  • 12+ years in People, employee experience, workplace, or internal communications, with 5+ years leading teams.
  • Proven ownership of at least two of: multi-country workplace or office operations, employee engagement, internal communications, or large-scale internal events.
  • Experience managing an intranet or other internal communications platforms, including content governance.
  • Experience in a high-growth, global company with employees in multiple countries.
  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable turning survey, occupancy, and channel data into decisions.
  • Excellent writing and editorial judgment, including drafting for senior executives.
  • Track record of managing budgets and vendors.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience working in the Gulf region and across Asia and Europe.
  • Hands-on use of AI and automation to improve employee services.
  • Familiarity with HRIS, engagement, and communications platforms (e.g., Workday, Culture Amp, Lark, Slack).
  • Arabic or Mandarin is a plus.

How you lead

  • Builder. You create programs from a blank page and scale them as the company grows.
  • Data-driven. You measure what matters and use it to decide where to invest.
  • Executive presence. You earn the trust of the CEO and senior leaders and can push back with care.
  • Global mindset. You design for many cultures, languages, and time zones, not one headquarters.
  • Bias for action. You move fast, test ideas, and learn from what doesn't work.
  • Integrity. You handle sensitive information and messages with discretion and judgment.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Are you excited by the idea of reshaping how value moves across borders? At Polygon Labs, we're building the future of on-chain finance - and we’re looking for somebody to drive that future in Mexico and Central America.

In this high-impact role, you'll lead efforts to expand our presence in the payments and stablecoins space, build deep collaborations with fintechs, financial institutions, and infrastructure players, and co-create go-to-market strategies that turn potential into real-world adoption. Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

We are seeking an AI Security Engineer to own the technical security controls for how Alpaca uses AI. The scope includes identity for AI agents and automations, security requirements for AI tools and integrations, guardrails, and security logging. You will also assist in developing AI-powered security tooling.

You will keep those controls consistent as AI adoption grows, and you will work with the teams building with AI so security is part of the design.

This role reports to the Enterprise Security Architect and works closely with AI Enablement, Engineering, DevOps, GRC, and the wider Security team.

The Security Team is 100% distributed and remote.

Things You Get To Do:

The core responsibilities of the AI Security Engineer are focused on AI access controls, secure AI platforms, guardrails, visibility into AI usage, and AI-powered security tooling.

AI Identity and Access Controls:

  • Agent Identity: Define how AI agents, bots, and automations authenticate, what they can access, and how their actions are attributed and audited.
  • Tool Access: Own security requirements for AI tool integrations, including least-privilege access and credential handling.
  • AI Assistant Controls: Define and enforce security settings for approved AI tools, including data handling and access policy.
  • Least Privilege: Limit each agent and integration to the access it needs, and review that access when the integration changes.

Secure AI Platform, Tooling, and Response:

  • Security Requirements: Define security requirements for internal AI applications, including identity, data handling, secrets, and review of new integrations.
  • Guardrails: Design and implement guardrails for AI applications and agents.
  • Design Reviews: Review new AI applications and integrations for security risks, and give builders clear, practical requirements.
  • Security Tooling: Assist Security Operations in developing AI-powered tooling that supports detection, investigation, and response work.
  • Safe Use in Security: Apply the same identity, data handling, and logging requirements to security team AI tools as to the rest of the company.
  • Telemetry Requirements: Define the security logging AI systems must produce, and work with Security Operations on detection.
  • Approved Use: Maintain visibility into AI tool usage and confirm it follows approved configurations.
  • Incident Support: Lead the AI-specific aspects of security incidents, such as agent misuse or data exposure through AI tools.
  • On-Call: Participate in the Security Operations on-call rotation after onboarding and cross-training.

Governance:

  • Standards: Turn AI security standards into technical controls.
  • GRC Partnership: Partner with GRC on AI governance and provide technical evidence for control design.

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • Excited about Alpaca’s mission and what we’re building
  • 2+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, or cloud security roles
  • Hands-on experience securing LLM applications, AI agents, or AI developer tools
  • Understanding of AI-specific risks, such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and insecure tool use (for example, the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)
  • Experience with identity and access controls for services and non-human identities, including OAuth, service accounts, and secrets management
  • Programming experience in Python or another general-purpose language
  • Experience with CI/CD security checks and cloud-native deployments
  • Experience with security operations or incident response
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially when explaining risk to non-security builders
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and making pragmatic security decisions
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows for security operations
  • Experience building security telemetry for AI systems

 Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):  

  • Experience securing financial, trading, or other highly regulated platforms
  • Experience securing enterprise AI coding tools and AI integrations
  • Experience with policy-as-code and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework or ISO 42001
  • Ability to balance security rigor with operational efficiency and business needs

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

The Americas Compliance team is hiring a Senior Compliance Manager to own compliance for OKXICE TSV. OKXICE TSV is the tokenized securities venue run by the OKX and Intercontinental Exchange joint venture under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, and it lets eligible US users trade tokenized US-listed stocks on-chain. You'll be the main person accountable for meeting the exemption's ongoing conditions. You'll work closely with Legal, Product, Web3 Risk Control and our AML, Sanctions and Surveillance teams. This is a new role on a new type of venue, so you'll help build the program as well as run it.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the compliance program for the venue's SEC exemption, including tracking each condition, testing controls and keeping records ready for regulatory examination.
  • Manage the venue's public notice: review revisions, control versions, and make sure the notice matches how the product actually works. This includes corrections and material-change filings within the required deadlines.
  • Run the issuer notice process from start to finish, including tracking delivery, handling objections and confirming each stock's listing date.
  • Track and monitor TSV limits on an ongoing basis, including per-stock and volume limits against consolidated market data, periodic tier rechecks, trading halts and eligible stablecoins. Escalate breaches, significant operational events and required SEC notifications.
  • Oversee participant onboarding and ongoing wallet maintenance and monitoring, including KYC/KYB, daily sanctions and on-chain wallet rescreening, keeping wallet-to-participant records current, and issuing and revoking the soulbound token (SBT) credential that grants access.
  • Report to the OKXICE LLC Board of Managers and to Americas Compliance leadership, and manage and develop a TSV Compliance Analyst.

What We Look For In You

  • 8+ years of compliance experience at a broker-dealer, exchange, alternative trading system (ATS) or digital asset firm, with direct experience of SEC-regulated activity.
  • Working knowledge of the federal securities laws that apply to trading venues, such as Regulation ATS, Regulation NMS and market manipulation rules, plus the ability to apply them to new market structures.
  • Experience building or running compliance programs under regulatory conditions, exemptive relief or no-action positions.
  • Familiarity with how blockchain-based trading works, including self-custodied wallets, smart contracts, liquidity pools and on-chain screening.
  • Strong drafting skills, with experience turning complex technical or legal detail into clear public disclosures and procedures.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to work with Product, Engineering and Legal teams across time zones.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with tokenized securities, transfer agents or digital asset broker-dealers.
  • Exposure to OFAC sanctions programs and blocked property handling for on-chain assets.
  • Experience reporting to a board or joint venture governance body.
  • A JD or a similar legal background.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Hut 8 brings exceptional people together to solve the world’s most consequential problems at the intersection of energy and technology. Today, that means building infrastructure for AI at a pace and scale without precedent. Tomorrow, it could mean powering a new era of innovation through robotics, advanced manufacturing, or an industry that does not yet exist. Whatever the technology demands, our ambition holds: to build the defining physical infrastructure company of our generation.

We look for thinkers and builders with the rigor, humility, and ownership to solve problems at this scale. They start from zero and choose truth over tradition. They back the best idea, whatever its source. They bet on themselves and embrace the hard truths that force them to grow. Our commitment is to keep the path from idea to execution short, trust them with critical decisions and the work that follows, and surround them with colleagues whose curiosity extends beyond their expertise.

BUILT DIFFERENT

We believe there's a better way to build. One that moves faster, thinks bigger, and gives people the ownership to challenge what's been done before. We're not here to follow the standard. We're here to set a new one. We don't believe the best work happens inside rigid boxes. People are given real ownership, real responsibility, and the space to operate beyond a title. Scope grows with impact and responsibility grows with trust. And the people who step up help shape what comes next. We're building an organization around ownership, where your influence is defined by what you take on. An internship at Hut 8 provides you with the opportunity to take on real work and drive real outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The infrastructure is ambitious. The people behind it should be too.

We’re looking for a Civil & Structural Engineering intern who is curious, asks “why,” and wants to do real engineering work from day one. You’ll work side by side with our engineers on live data center projects, contribute to designs and calculations that actually get built, and leave with work you can point to.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

+  Learn it: Get hands-on with the civil and structural systems behind a data center: foundations, structural steel and concrete framing, site grading and drainage, and equipment anchorage

+  Support it: Help our engineers with load calculations, member and foundation sizing, grading and drainage layouts, and drawing markups, with guidance and review from licensed PEs

+  See it built: Join site visits, follow field issues from question to fix, and watch a design turn into excavation, foundations, and structure

+  Challenge it: Ask hard questions about cost, constructability, and redundancy. Fresh eyes are an asset here, and safety and reliability always come first

+  Own it: Take on a defined project of your own, from first question to final recommendation, and present it to the team at the end of your internship

WHAT YOU BRING

+  Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s program in Civil or Structural Engineering or a closely related field, such as Architectural Engineering (structural), Construction Engineering, or Environmental Engineering with a structures or site-design foundation

+  Graduating in December 2027 or June 2028 with an undergraduate or graduate degree

+  Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.3

+  Coursework in structural analysis, reinforced concrete or steel design, geotechnical engineering, or hydrology

+  Real interest in site and structural design for data center infrastructure

+  Comfort with AutoCAD, MATLAB, or Python, and the ability to pick up new engineering software quickly

+  Track record of personal accountability, integrity, and respect for others, the company, and oneself

+  Exceptional interpersonal skills to support team cohesion and successful project execution

+  Strong written and verbal communication skills for working with diverse groups and individuals

+  Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines, while contributing to inclusive and cooperative teams

+  Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

BUILT FOR THIS

We are looking for a Product Manager with a deep understanding of TradingView users, strong commercial judgment, and experience driving product growth. You will grow OKX's business within the TradingView ecosystem by identifying the most promising customer segments, defining why traders should choose OKX, and finding effective ways to acquire, activate, and retain them, with accountability for measurable business outcomes.
Your first priority is to establish how the business can grow and which opportunities warrant investment. Those insights will shape the product roadmap, investment priorities, and the TradingView integrations and trading experience improvements you deliver with engineering and partners.

  • Define the Growth Strategy and Business Opportunity — 
    Identify high-potential customer segments, trading use cases, and market opportunities within the TradingView ecosystem. Assess competitive positioning, platform selection drivers, and OKX's differentiated value proposition. Build growth hypotheses and business cases that consider audience size, revenue potential, acquisition cost, and expected return, then set business goals, priorities, and a phased growth plan.
  • Understand Users and the Trading Conversion Journey — 
    Use interviews, behavioral data, and community feedback to understand how traders discover platforms, use charts and indicators, set alerts, connect accounts, place orders, and manage positions. Identify what motivates or prevents users from choosing OKX, making their first trade, and returning. Develop customer segments and conversion funnels, and turn insights into clear product, positioning, and lifecycle opportunities.
  • Validate Growth Hypotheses and Improve Conversion and Retention — 
    Design measurable experiments across acquisition, account connection, first successful trade, repeat trading, and reactivation. Use existing capabilities, onboarding, trader education, value proposition testing, and targeted campaigns to validate opportunities. Define success metrics, experiment costs, and criteria to scale or stop; expand approaches that work and use the evidence to inform subsequent product investment.
  • Drive Go-To-Market and Ecosystem Partnerships —

Evaluate ecosystem visibility, communities, creators, educational content, and joint campaigns as potential channels. Define the customer proposition, distribution approach, conversion journey, and partner objectives, and assess channels by the active traders, retention, and business contribution they generate.

    Own metrics for newly acquired trading users, first-trade conversion, active traders, retention, incremental trading volume, and revenue contribution, taking acquisition, incentive, and delivery costs into account. Separate the effects of market conditions, incentives, and product improvements. Review growth initiatives and feature investments, reallocate resources based on results, and track connection success and trading reliability as measures of experience quality.

What We Look For In You

You can explain why different traders choose a platform, switch terminals, abandon an order, or continue using a service, and validate those insights through research and data.
